what: bun dev terminated a healthy but slow-starting Inspector, requiring a separate launch.
expected: bun dev owns Inspector through cold compilation, advertises readiness only after a complete HTTP response, and recovers failed reloads without restarting the Inspector.
observed: The actual CLI served the backend, then emitted dev.inspector.failed and terminated its delayed real Inspector child after five seconds.
root_cause: waitInspectorReady in packages/cli/src/commands/dev-inspector-support.service.ts applied Effect.timeout(5000) to the entire first-page HTTP probe; timeout unwound the scoped child owner during legitimate startup.

before.note: Actual bun dev with six-second delayed real Next launch terminated Inspector at five seconds.
TestClock shows readiness already failed at 5.5 seconds.

notes: An undelayed cold replay completed inside five seconds on this machine; the explicit six-second launch delay makes the known timing defect reproducible.

Read-only repos/effect checkout lacks Effect/Schedule/TestClock implementations and dedicated tests; checked installed Effect 4.0.1 source/examples and available upstream Vitest timeout/finalizer tests.
